title: Introducing Safe Return Emergency Autoland
summary: Cirrus introduces Safe Return, an emergency autoland system for its Vision Jet. A passenger presses a single button and the aircraft squawks emergency, reroutes and lands itself.
why: HN points to it as a real example of certified emergency autoland, used in debates about autonomy and pilotless aircraft.

quote.text: If it activates, the plane is squawking emergency to ATC
